certificate_arn.description: Optional ACM certificate ARN. When non-empty, an HTTPS listener with the identical authenticate-cognito -> forward action pair is created, the port-80 listener becomes a 301 redirect to HTTPS, and TCP 443 ingress is opened on the ALB security group. Leave empty (default) so apply runs unattended with only the HTTP listener.
